thread:
kim_vendor: hi team, update from the forwarder — a subset of the H200 shipment is on customs hold in FRA due to an HS-code reclass. they flagged 12 units (serials attached)
alex_infra: copy — can you paste the serials and AWB? we need to reconcile against the depot manifest before deciding next steps
kim_vendor: AWB: DE1234567890, serials: H200-AX12, H200-AX13, H200-AX14, H200-BX21, H200-BX22, H200-CX30, plus 6 more. i'll DM the full list to marc_procure and luca_logistics
marc_procure: got the DM. also forwarded to finance — heads up that the vendor is asking for a temporary reclaim hold + additional export docs cost (~€750) if we want immediate release
luca_logistics: FRA customs says reclass could take 48–72h. alternative is to reroute 6 units on a separate AWB to AMS (longer transit but faster clear). thoughts?
sam_sre: cluster note — our EU-dedicated pool is down 8% capacity today after recent DOAs, and the H200s are scheduled to replace them. if we delay more than 72h we may breach the Dedicated SLA for a few customers
kim_vendor: vendor can do partial air-replace (express) but adds surcharge, ETA 36h to FRA + customs clearance. price delta ~€2.5k per unit for air express. ground reroute to AMS is cheaper but ETA 96h
alex_infra: prioritize minimizing SLA risk. what's the cheapest immediate option to get at least 6 units live within 48h?
luca_logistics: cheapest to hit 48h is vendor express + paying customs broker fee and the reclassification paperwork. total per-unit delta ~€3.2k incl broker. reroute won't hit 48h
marc_procure: thumbs, we can absorb one-time surcharge from contingency budget if ops approves. ops-bot: @ops-team approval requested: one-time vendor expedite + customs broker fee for up to 6 H200 units to avoid SLA impact :rotating_light:
ops-bot: approval logged — budget hold code: OPS-EMG-2026-04. please attach final invoice to the ticket
sam_sre: once they arrive, can we deploy them as temporary pool with network isolation? we need to avoid any config drift. alex_infra can you run the quick preflight?
alex_infra: yes — plan: 1) serial reconciliation against depot manifest 2) run preflight image v2.3 3) apply network ACLs from template `eu-temp-pool` 4) smoke test + add to autoscale. should be ~1.5h per unit
kim_vendor: vendor will send full serial CSV and expedited AWB by EOD. also offered refurbished replacements for 4 units (discounted), but warranty is 90d instead of standard 12mo. want to confirm if accepted
marc_procure: we should avoid short-warranty unless we have no option. accept only if vendor credits per-unit replacement equal to >30% discount, and we add return-for-refurb clause
luca_logistics: if we accept refurb, need to tag them in inventory as 'refurb-shortwarranty' and schedule depot QA on arrival. that adds ~4h per unit processing
sam_sre: short warranty is risky for production customers. prefer express new units. if finance pushes back, accept up to 2 refurbished as stopgaps, with parity in performance tests required
kim_vendor: understood. i'll push for 6 new express units and offer 2 refurb as fallback. sending AWB + serial CSV now: https://files.vendor.com/shipments/DE1234567890.csv
alex_infra: received CSV, starting manifest reconcile. will update thread with any mismatches
marc_procure: thanks. marc — pinging @kim_vendor — please include the vendor invoice line items in separate CSV so finance can reconcile the OPS-EMG hold quickly
kim_vendor: will do. ping me if customs asks for any additional certificates — we have the supplier declaration and original invoice ready
ops-bot: deploy-bot noted a planned canary for this fleet tonight at 02:00 UTC. recommendation: hold canary until at least 2 new units are in pool to avoid regression exposure. ops-bot: annotation: CANARY-HOLD-3467123456
sam_sre: good call. i'll pause the canary and flag the release runbook. once 2 units pass smoke we can proceed with reduced ratio
alex_infra: manifest reconcile shows 1 serial mismatch (H200-BX22 not in CSV). emailing vendor ops to confirm
kim_vendor: saw your email, vendor investigating — they think BX22 was swapped at depot, sending probe. will update in ~30m
luca_logistics: if BX22 is lost in transit we need to open RMA with forwarder and vendor. please keep the lost-serial process checklist handy: `RMA -> AWB claim -> insurance -> provision replacement`
marc_procure: noted. i'll prepare the PO amendment for expedite and set aside approval for refurb fallback
kim_vendor: update: vendor confirms BX22 mis-ship, they can either 1) dispatch express replacement within 36h or 2) issue credit and attempt a depot repair (7–10 days). choosing option 1 triggers the surcharge
alex_infra: proceed with option 1 to protect SLA. alex_infra: actioning preflight queue and will reserve two staging racks for fast-mount
sam_sre: i'll adjust autoscale policies to tolerate temporary +5% capacity variance and monitor errors. set alert if pod evictions rise >2%
kim_vendor: thanks all — i'll confirm invoice and AWB for express replacements and close the customs hold if broker clears.
marc_procure: once invoice is in, i'll route through finance with OPS-EMG code. meet again in thread in 30m for final sign-off.
